continuity_contract.character_topology: declare the exact visible characters, separations, fusions and forbidden anatomy changes
continuity_contract.wardrobe_lock: declare immutable costume, accessory and absorbed-form clothing
continuity_contract.power_state: declare the state entering and leaving this take
continuity_contract.entry_motion: declare body, object and camera direction inherited from the previous cut
continuity_contract.exit_motion: declare the moving state handed to the next take
continuity_contract.impact_language: declare contact, recoil, displacement, cloth, dust, debris and environment response

takes.objective: Apresentar o mundo visual e o clima.

shot_contract.subject: ambiente, objeto ou personagem principal do take

camera.angle: eye level, low angle, high angle ou top shot
camera.movement: dolly, truck, crane, arc, pan, tilt, rack focus ou drone
camera.focus: deep focus, rack focus ou subject locked

camera_evidence.movement: physical dolly, truck, crane, tracking or orbit
camera_evidence.perspective_change: describe the visible viewpoint and overlap change

real_depth.differential_motion: describe different apparent speeds across all three planes
real_depth.occlusion_or_scale_change: describe a coherent overlap, occlusion or scale change

internal_action.primary_event: one physical event with a visible consequence
independent_elements: first element moving independently from the camera
second element moving independently from the camera

progression.middle: event develops and changes the scene
progression.end_state_change: what remains different at the cut
progression.exit_or_cut: hard cut, musical impact or directional exit into the next take

continuity.entry_motion: describe the exact body, object and camera velocity inherited from the preceding take
continuity.exit_motion: describe the exact moving state handed into the following take

interval_motion.early_0_30: describe useful inherited motion during the first 30 percent
interval_motion.middle_30_70: describe the irreversible action developing during the middle 40 percent
interval_motion.late_70_100: describe consequence and moving handoff through the final 30 percent

moving_anchor_context.start_source: source take and frame with visible motion before and after
moving_anchor_context.end_source: destination take and frame with visible motion before and after

negative_rules: no camera drift without perspective change
no particles or light as the only event

control_claims.rule: timeline_exact must be implemented as adjacent first-last segments; exact_pose must use a graph with a real pose-conditioning input

video.preview_model: MiniMax H3 FL2VA pruned INT8 ConvRot + Qwen3-VL-32B
video.final_model: owner-approved MiniMax H3 take + RIFE 4.6 + RealESRGAN FHD

motion_layers.camera: evident physical translation with visible perspective change
motion_layers.foreground: fastest coherent displacement, overlap or occlusion change
motion_layers.midground: independent action and medium differential displacement
motion_layers.background: slowest coherent displacement with stable geography
motion_layers.internal_action: one physical event plus at least two independently moving elements
motion_layers.lighting_particles: supporting motion only; never the sole event

takes.animation_prompt: Animate this approved image as a real cinematic shot, not a living photo. Use evident physical camera translation, real three-plane depth, one physical event plus two independent scene motions, and materially different beginning, middle and end states. Finish on a motivated cut or directional exit. Preserve approved identity, geography, objects, colors and style. No text, watermark or native audio.

approval_criteria: evident physical camera movement and perspective change
real foreground, midground and background depth
internal action independent from the camera
clear progression through different start, middle and end states
